profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing inline components and curating KPIs for agents in Azure Copilot

positions.title: President of ACM-W
positions.description: Leader of ACM-W, a committee that advocates for the diversity and inclusion of all groups in the computer science field; delegating tasks to four officers, coordinating with them to offer educational programs and events.

positions.title: ACM-W Outreach Director
positions.description: Board member of ACM-W, a committee that advocates for the diversity and inclusion of all groups in the computer science field; planning large events including QWER Hacks and the Women in Engineering Stayover Program.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern, Tableau
positions.description: Active member of Tableau's Product Supportability team that focuses on providing new features that make Tableau products easier to support; spearheaded development of CleanRepro feature in C++ to reduce customer Time to Resolution in incidences of Tableau failure and automate portions of resolution process; wrote unit tests utilizing Catch2 framework to ensure proper functionality of CleanRepro product code.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Contributed to the Enforcer team of Prisma Cloud identity-based microsegmentation product to reduce threat risk on cloud native applications; implemented unit tests within large, existing Golang code base to increase code coverage; collaborated with team members using Git to deliver better products to customers.

positions.title: Academic Mentoring Intern
positions.description: Mentored a cohort of undergraduate students at UCLA in their computer science classes, particularly in data structures; prepared lesson plans reviewing challenging CS concepts and went through practice problems; worked in collaboration with CEO and CTO to refine program offerings and improve support for students; marketed program to UCLA students on a variety of platforms.

honors.title: Third Place in Healthcare Track of QWER Hacks
honors.description: I worked with a partner to build a mental-health and self-care focused website using React. Some features include a page to rate how the user is feeling on that day, a page suggesting self-care activities, as well as a calendar where the user can see their ratings from the past week and also reflect on what activities the user did to improve their mood and practice self-care.
